blocks.zh: §4.10–4.11：雙重 CGMP 合規、上市後義務與 CDMO 責任
blocks.en: §4.10–4.11: Dual CGMP Compliance, Post-Market Obligations and CDMO Responsibilities

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 §4.4(b) 精簡化合規路徑（streamlined approach）的實質意義——廠方無需重複執行每條法規，但必須以文件證明等效性（functional equivalence）
blocks.en: Understand the practical meaning of the §4.4(b) streamlined compliance approach: the site does not need to run every regulation twice, but must document functional equivalence

blocks.zh: 掌握 21 CFR Part 211（藥品）與 21 CFR Part 820（醫療器材）六大核心領域的對照要求，能夠設計符合雙重 CGMP 的整合品質系統
blocks.en: Master the side-by-side requirements of 21 CFR Part 211 (drugs) and 21 CFR Part 820 (medical devices) across six core areas, and be able to design an integrated quality system that meets dual CGMP

blocks.zh: 識別組合產品上市後的 ADE/MDR 雙軌報告義務，正確判斷何時需向 FAERS 以及何時需向 MDR 系統報告
blocks.en: Identify the dual ADE/MDR post-market reporting obligations for combination products, and correctly determine when to report to FAERS and when to report to the MDR system

blocks.zh: 釐清 CDMO 在組合產品製造中的法規責任邊界——何種情境下 Part 211 與 Part 820 同時適用，以及品質協議（Quality Agreement）必須涵蓋的關鍵條款
blocks.en: Clarify the boundaries of a CDMO's regulatory responsibility in combination product manufacturing: when Part 211 and Part 820 apply at the same time, and the key clauses a Quality Agreement must cover

blocks.zh: 了解 FDA 查廠對組合產品雙重 CGMP 實施的檢查重點，以及任一中心開出 OAI 的連鎖影響
blocks.en: Understand the focus of FDA inspections of dual CGMP implementation for combination products, and the knock-on effects of an OAI classification from either center

blocks.zh: 3.1 §4.4 — Combination Product CGMP Requirements: The Streamlined Approach 3.1 §4.4 — 組合產品 CGMP 要求：精簡化方法
blocks.en: 3.1 §4.4 — Combination Product CGMP Requirements: The Streamlined Approach

blocks.zh: Regulatory Framework 法規架構
blocks.en: Regulatory Framework

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 雙重 CGMP：三種情境 Three Scenarios
blocks.en: Dual CGMP: Three Scenarios

blocks.zh: 理解 §4.4 最好的方法是區分三種情境：
blocks.en: The best way to understand §4.4 is to distinguish three scenarios:

blocks.zh: 情境 A（最常見）：以主導中心的 CGMP 框架為主系統，精簡化合規——文件證明另一套要求已被現行系統滿足。例：藥品主導的自動注射器，主系統 Part 211，以交叉比對文件證明 Part 820 要求已被滿足。
blocks.en: Scenario A (most common): The lead center's CGMP framework is the primary system, with streamlined compliance: documentation shows that the other set of requirements is already satisfied by the existing system. Example: for a drug-led autoinjector, the primary system is Part 211, and a cross-reference document shows that the Part 820 requirements are met.

blocks.zh: 情境 B：完整雙系統——同時維護 Part 211 和 Part 820 的完整程序，無任何整合。此方式合法但費時，適用於生產線同時製造純藥品和純器材的廠房。
blocks.en: Scenario B: Full dual systems: complete procedures for both Part 211 and Part 820 are maintained, with no integration. This is permissible but time-consuming, and suits sites whose lines make both pure drug products and pure device products.

blocks.zh: 情境 C（違規）：只執行一套系統，沒有交叉比對文件，也沒有評估另一套要求是否被滿足。FDA 查廠時會直接開 483。
blocks.en: Scenario C (non-compliant): Only one system is run, with no cross-reference document and no assessment of whether the other set of requirements is met. FDA will issue a 483 directly during an inspection.

blocks.zh: 絕大多數 CDMO 選擇情境 A。關鍵不是「用哪套」，而是「有沒有文件」。
blocks.en: The vast majority of CDMOs choose Scenario A. The key is not "which set you use" but "whether you have the documentation."

blocks.zh: 比喻：同一工廠，同時滿足兩套標準 The Dual-Standard Factory
blocks.en: Analogy: The Dual-Standard Factory

blocks.zh: 想像一家汽車工廠，既要符合碰撞安全標準（NHTSA），也要符合排放標準（EPA）。工廠不需要建兩條獨立生產線——同一條生產線、同一組工人、同一套品質系統，但必須能向 NHTSA 展示如何滿足碰撞安全要求，同時向 EPA 展示如何滿足排放要求。
blocks.en: Imagine an automobile plant that must meet both crash safety standards (NHTSA) and emissions standards (EPA). The plant does not need two separate production lines: it has the same line, the same workers and the same quality system, but it must be able to show NHTSA how it meets the crash safety requirements and show EPA how it meets the emissions requirements.

blocks.zh: 組合產品的雙重 CGMP 邏輯完全相同：同一個品質系統，必須以文件證明它同時滿足 Part 211（藥品監管機關的「碰撞安全標準」）和 Part 820（器材監管機關的「排放標準」）。
blocks.en: The dual CGMP logic for combination products is exactly the same: a single quality system must be documented as meeting both Part 211 (the drug regulator's "crash safety standard") and Part 820 (the device regulator's "emissions standard").

blocks.zh: 文件，是這個比喻的核心。 工廠必須能拿出清晰的書面說明，而不只是口頭宣稱「我們都有做到」。
blocks.en: Documentation is the heart of this analogy. The plant must be able to produce a clear written explanation, not merely claim verbally that "we do all of it."

blocks.zh: 精簡化路徑的四步驟執行框架
blocks.en: Four-Step Framework for Executing the Streamlined Approach

blocks.zh: Step 1 — 確定主導法規框架：根據組合產品的主導中心（CDER/CBER → Part 211；CDRH → Part 820），選定主 CGMP 系統。
blocks.en: Step 1 — Determine the governing regulatory framework: Select the primary CGMP system based on the combination product's lead center (CDER/CBER → Part 211; CDRH → Part 820).

blocks.zh: Step 2 — 識別「獨特要求」：逐條比較主系統與次系統的要求，找出次系統中有而主系統無的要求（例：Part 820 的 §820.100 CAPA 是顯性要求，Part 211 無對應條款但 CAPA 精神隱含其中）。
blocks.en: Step 2 — Identify the "unique requirements": Compare the primary and secondary systems requirement by requirement, and find the requirements in the secondary system that the primary system lacks (e.g., CAPA under §820.100 of Part 820 is an explicit requirement; Part 211 has no corresponding provision, although the spirit of CAPA is implicit in it).

blocks.zh: Step 3 — 文件化交叉比對（Gap Analysis Crosswalk）：對每一條次系統要求，說明現行主系統的哪個程序、記錄或控制措施如何滿足它。若無法滿足，則補充相應控制。
blocks.en: Step 3 — Document the cross-reference (Gap Analysis Crosswalk): For each secondary-system requirement, explain which procedure, record or control in the existing primary system satisfies it. If it cannot be satisfied, add the corresponding control.

blocks.zh: Step 4 — 持續更新：任何主系統程序的變更，都需同步評估對次系統要求的影響，並更新交叉比對文件。
blocks.en: Step 4 — Keep it current: Any change to a primary-system procedure must also be assessed for its impact on the secondary-system requirements, and the cross-reference document must be updated.

blocks.zh: 常見誤解 Common Misconception
blocks.en: Common Misconception

blocks.zh: 誤解：「我們只需要符合主導中心的要求，另一套不適用。」
blocks.en: Misconception: "We only need to comply with the lead center's requirements; the other set does not apply."

blocks.zh: 這是錯誤的。§4.4(a) 的預設規則是兩套都要符合。§4.4(b) 的精簡化路徑是一種替代方式——允許以一套系統實現兩套要求，但前提是有文件證明等效性。不是說另一套「不適用」，而是「我的系統已經滿足了」。
blocks.en: This is wrong. The default rule in §4.4(a) is that both sets must be met. The streamlined approach in §4.4(b) is an alternative that allows one system to fulfill both sets of requirements, but only if equivalence is documented. It does not mean the other set "does not apply"; it means "my system already satisfies it."

blocks.zh: 查廠時，FDA 官員會問：「您的系統如何滿足 §820.100 CAPA 要求？」如果廠方回答「那是器材的要求，我們是藥廠，不適用」，這就直接構成 483 觀察。
blocks.en: During an inspection, an FDA investigator will ask: "How does your system meet the §820.100 CAPA requirement?" If the site answers, "That is a device requirement; we are a drug manufacturer, so it does not apply," that alone constitutes a 483 observation.

blocks.zh: 3.2 Practical Dual CGMP Implementation — Side-by-Side Comparison 3.2 雙重 CGMP 實務執行 — 並列比較
blocks.en: 3.2 Practical Dual CGMP Implementation — Side-by-Side Comparison

blocks.zh: 211 vs. 820 — Six Critical Areas 六大核心領域對照
blocks.en: 211 vs. 820 — Six Critical Areas

blocks.zh: 表格的實務意義：CAPA 是整合重點
blocks.en: Practical Meaning of the Table: CAPA Is the Integration Focus

blocks.zh: 對大多數藥廠出身的 CDMO 來說，這張表格中最需要注意的是 CAPA。
blocks.en: For most CDMOs with a pharmaceutical background, the item in this table that needs the most attention is CAPA.

blocks.zh: 藥廠 QMS 通常沒有獨立的「CAPA 程序」——偏差調查、變更管制、OOS 調查各自處理，CAPA 的精神分散在多個 SOP 中。但 §820.100 要求的是一個整合的、顯性的 CAPA 系統，必須有正式的 CAPA 啟動準則、根因分析方法論、有效性驗證計畫、和趨勢分析機制。
blocks.en: A pharmaceutical QMS usually has no standalone "CAPA procedure": deviation investigation, change control and OOS investigation are each handled separately, and the spirit of CAPA is spread across several SOPs. But §820.100 requires an integrated, explicit CAPA system, which must have formal CAPA initiation criteria, a root cause analysis methodology, an effectiveness verification plan and a trending mechanism.

blocks.zh: FDA 在組合產品 CGMP 指引中明確說明：即使藥廠的主 CGMP 是 Part 211，仍需建立符合 §820.100 精神的 CAPA 系統，並在交叉比對文件中說明。
blocks.en: FDA states explicitly in its combination product CGMP guidance that even when a drug manufacturer's primary CGMP is Part 211, it must still establish a CAPA system consistent with the spirit of §820.100 and explain it in the cross-reference document.

blocks.zh: 雙重 CGMP 差距分析交叉比對方法 Gap Analysis Crosswalk Framework
blocks.en: Gap Analysis Crosswalk Framework

blocks.zh: 交叉比對文件的標準格式（以藥品主導、Part 211 為主系統為例）：
blocks.en: Standard format for a cross-reference document (using a drug-led product with Part 211 as the primary system):

blocks.zh:
Part 820 要求          | 現行 Part 211 對應控制           | 差距？| 補充措施
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
§820.20 Management     | §211.22 QC unit responsibilities  | 部分  | 補充 Management
  Responsibility       | + QMS Policy                      |       | Review 程序
§820.30 Design Controls| NDA/ANDA CMC + Design Dossier    | 是    | 建立 §820.30
                       | (device constituent)              |       | 設計管控 SOP
§820.50 Purchasing     | §211.84 incoming testing          | 部分  | 補充供應商
  Controls             | + vendor qualification SOP        |       | 核准清單管理
§820.75 Process Val.   | §211.68 + FDA PV Guidance 2011   | 否    | 現行系統等效
§820.100 CAPA          | §211.192 investigation + NCR      | 是    | 建立整合 CAPA
                       | system                            |       | SOP (§820.100)
§820.184 DHR           | §211.188 BPR (partial)            | 部分  | BPR 增加 DHR
                       |                                   |       | 必要元素
§820.198 Complaints    | §211.198 complaints               | 部分  | 增加 MDR 評估
                       |                                   |       | 步驟至現行 SOP
blocks.en:
Part 820 requirement    | Existing Part 211 control         | Gap? | Supplementary action
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
§820.20 Management     | §211.22 QC unit responsibilities  | Partial | Add Management
  Responsibility       | + QMS Policy                      |       | Review procedure
§820.30 Design Controls| NDA/ANDA CMC + Design Dossier    | Yes   | Establish §820.30
                       | (device constituent)              |       | design control SOP
§820.50 Purchasing     | §211.84 incoming testing          | Partial | Add approved supplier
  Controls             | + vendor qualification SOP        |       | list management
§820.75 Process Val.   | §211.68 + FDA PV Guidance 2011   | No    | Existing system equivalent
§820.100 CAPA          | §211.192 investigation + NCR      | Yes   | Establish integrated CAPA
                       | system                            |       | SOP (§820.100)
§820.184 DHR           | §211.188 BPR (partial)            | Partial | Add required DHR
                       |                                   |       | elements to BPR
§820.198 Complaints    | §211.198 complaints               | Partial | Add MDR assessment
                       |                                   |       | step to existing SOP

blocks.zh: 此格式是 FDA 查廠時最有說服力的合規證明——不需要新建系統，只需要清晰的文件說明現行控制如何達到等效要求，以及真正的差距如何被補充。
blocks.en: This format is the most persuasive compliance evidence during an FDA inspection: no new system needs to be built, only a clear document explaining how existing controls achieve equivalence and how any real gaps are closed.

blocks.zh: BPR 與 DHR 整合的實務做法
blocks.en: Practical Approach to Integrating the BPR and DHR

blocks.zh: 藥廠習慣於「批次生產記錄（BPR）」，器材廠習慣於「設備歷史記錄（DHR）」。對於組合產品，最有效率的做法是在 BPR 中增加 DHR 必要元素：
blocks.en: Drug manufacturers are used to the "batch production record (BPR)," while device manufacturers are used to the "device history record (DHR)." For combination products, the most efficient approach is to add the required DHR elements to the BPR:

blocks.zh: 自動注射器組件批號（autoinjector component lot number）
blocks.en: Autoinjector component lot number

blocks.zh: 組裝工站記錄（assembly station records）
blocks.en: Assembly station records

blocks.zh: 力矩值記錄（torque records for cap/closure）
blocks.en: Torque records for cap/closure

blocks.zh: 功能測試結果（delivery device function test results）
blocks.en: Delivery device function test results

blocks.zh: 器材外觀檢查結果（device visual inspection results）
blocks.en: Device visual inspection results

blocks.zh: 反過來，DHR 中應引用藥品批號（drug batch number），以建立完整的追溯鏈（traceability chain）。
blocks.en: Conversely, the DHR should reference the drug batch number to establish a complete traceability chain.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一家以 Part 211 為主系統的 CDMO 正在申請組合產品製造資格。審計員問：「您的 CAPA 程序如何滿足 §820.100？」請說明如何回答，以及交叉比對文件應如何記錄。
blocks.en: A CDMO with Part 211 as its primary system is applying for combination product manufacturing qualification. The auditor asks: "How does your CAPA procedure meet §820.100?" Explain how to answer, and how the cross-reference document should record it.

blocks.zh: 當一個組合產品的自動注射器針帽設計從矽油潤滑改為乾式塗層，這個變更觸發了哪些法規路徑？（提示：考慮 §820.30 設計變更、NDA CMC 補充、以及是否需要重新驗證。）
blocks.en: When the needle cap design of a combination product's autoinjector changes from silicone oil lubrication to a dry coating, which regulatory pathways does the change trigger? (Hint: consider a §820.30 design change, an NDA CMC supplement, and whether revalidation is needed.)

blocks.zh: 公司在 BPR 中記錄了藥品批次資訊，但 DHR 必需元素（§820.184）未整合。FDA 483 觀察如何引用？應如何補救？
blocks.en: A company records drug batch information in the BPR, but the DHR elements required by §820.184 are not integrated. How would an FDA 483 observation cite this? How should it be remediated?

blocks.zh: 3.3 Post-Market Reporting Obligations — Dual Reporting Pathways 3.3 上市後報告義務 — 雙重報告途徑
blocks.en: 3.3 Post-Market Reporting Obligations — Dual Reporting Pathways

blocks.zh: Post-Market Regulatory Framework 上市後法規框架
blocks.en: Post-Market Regulatory Framework

blocks.zh: 品質協議中的不良事件報告條款 Quality Agreement AE Clauses
blocks.en: Adverse Event Clauses in the Quality Agreement

blocks.zh: 組合產品品質協議必須明確規定：
blocks.en: A combination product quality agreement must clearly specify:

blocks.zh: 通報時限： CDMO 在知悉客訴或不良事件後的多少小時內必須通知 NDA/PMA 持有人（通常：嚴重事件 24–48 小時，一般事件 5 個工作日）
blocks.en: Notification timeline: Within how many hours of becoming aware of a complaint or adverse event the CDMO must notify the NDA/PMA holder (typically 24–48 hours for serious events and 5 working days for general events)

blocks.zh: 誰評估 MDR 資格： CDMO 還是 NDA 持有人負責首次 MDR 可報性評估？
blocks.en: Who assesses MDR eligibility: Does the CDMO or the NDA holder perform the initial MDR reportability assessment?

blocks.zh: 誰提交 MDR： CDMO 直接向 CDRH 提交，還是由 NDA 持有人整合提交？
blocks.en: Who submits the MDR: Does the CDMO submit directly to CDRH, or does the NDA holder submit on a consolidated basis?

blocks.zh: 資訊共享： NDA 持有人的 ADE 數據庫是否與 CDMO 共享？CDMO 如何知悉已上市產品的安全信號？
blocks.en: Information sharing: Is the NDA holder's ADE database shared with the CDMO? How does the CDMO learn of safety signals for marketed products?

blocks.zh: FSCA（Field Safety Corrective Action）觸發： 誰有權決定啟動回收或 FSCA？
blocks.en: FSCA (Field Safety Corrective Action) trigger: Who has the authority to decide to initiate a recall or an FSCA?

blocks.zh: 上市後研究：CDMO 的隱藏義務 Post-Market Studies: Hidden CDMO Obligations
blocks.en: Post-Market Studies: Hidden CDMO Obligations

blocks.zh: NDA 持有人或 PMA 持有人可能在上市後承諾（PMC）中納入與製造商相關的義務，例如：
blocks.en: An NDA holder or PMA holder may include manufacturer-related obligations in its post-marketing commitments (PMCs), for example:

blocks.zh: 提供特定批次用於上市後穩定性研究（涉及 CDMO 的樣品保留義務）
blocks.en: Providing specific batches for post-market stability studies (which involves the CDMO's sample retention obligations)

blocks.zh: 支持 PAS（Post-Approval Study）的數據提交（涉及 CDMO 的製造數據記錄要求）
blocks.en: Supporting data submission for a PAS (Post-Approval Study) (which involves the CDMO's manufacturing data recording requirements)

blocks.zh: §522 監測研究可能要求 CDMO 提供製造記錄以支持真實世界數據分析
blocks.en: §522 surveillance studies may require the CDMO to provide manufacturing records to support real-world data analysis

blocks.zh: 品質協議中必須明確這些義務的分工，否則 CDMO 可能在不知情的情況下違反了 PMC 承諾。
blocks.en: The quality agreement must clearly allocate these obligations; otherwise the CDMO may breach a PMC commitment without knowing it.

blocks.zh: 情境練習 Scenario Practice
blocks.en: Scenario Practice

blocks.zh: 情境： 一名患者使用藥品主導的預填充注射器後出現注射部位嚴重感染。初步調查顯示可能是針頭護帽設計缺陷導致無菌屏障失效，同時患者報告注射後立即出現藥物過敏反應。
blocks.en: Scenario: A patient develops a serious injection site infection after using a drug-led prefilled syringe. A preliminary investigation suggests that a needle shield design defect may have caused a sterile barrier failure, and the patient also reports an immediate drug allergic reaction after the injection.

blocks.zh: 這個事件是否觸發 ADE 報告義務？由誰提交？時限是多少？
blocks.en: Does this event trigger an ADE reporting obligation? Who submits, and what is the deadline?

blocks.zh: 這個事件是否觸發 MDR 義務？誰是必須評估的責任方？
blocks.en: Does this event trigger an MDR obligation? Which party is responsible for the assessment?

blocks.zh: 如果 CDMO 是預填充注射器的最終組裝商，CDMO 的獨立報告義務是什麼？
blocks.en: If the CDMO is the final assembler of the prefilled syringe, what is the CDMO's independent reporting obligation?

blocks.zh: 品質協議中哪些條款需要被激活？
blocks.en: Which quality agreement clauses need to be activated?

blocks.zh: ADE vs. MDR：兩套報告系統的關鍵差異
blocks.en: ADE vs. MDR: Key Differences Between the Two Reporting Systems

blocks.zh: 這是 CDMO 品保人員最容易混淆的區域。關鍵區別：
blocks.en: This is the area CDMO QA staff most often confuse. The key distinctions:

blocks.zh: 關鍵警示： MDR 的報告責任落在「製造商」，不只是 NDA/BLA 持有人。如果 CDMO 是該組合產品器材成分的製造商（或最終組裝商），其 MDR 報告義務是獨立的——即使 NDA 持有人已提交 ADE 報告，CDMO 仍需自行評估是否需要提交 MDR。
blocks.en: Key warning: The MDR reporting responsibility falls on the "manufacturer," not only on the NDA/BLA holder. If the CDMO is the manufacturer (or final assembler) of the combination product's device constituent part, its MDR reporting obligation is independent: even if the NDA holder has already submitted an ADE report, the CDMO must still assess for itself whether an MDR is required.

blocks.zh: 3.4 CDMO Responsibilities in Combination Product Manufacturing 3.4 CDMO 在組合產品製造中的職責
blocks.en: 3.4 CDMO Responsibilities in Combination Product Manufacturing

blocks.zh: CDMO Regulatory Scope 委託製造商的法規責任
blocks.en: CDMO Regulatory Scope

blocks.zh: CDMO 最大陷阱 The CDMO Trap — "We Only Do Fill-Finish"
blocks.en: The CDMO Trap — "We Only Do Fill-Finish"

blocks.zh: 最常見的 CDMO 合規誤解：
blocks.en: The most common CDMO compliance misunderstanding:

blocks.zh: 「我們只負責藥品灌裝（fill-finish），器材的 CGMP 不適用於我們。」
blocks.en: "We are only responsible for drug fill-finish; device CGMP does not apply to us."

blocks.zh: 這是錯誤的，在以下情境下尤其危險：
blocks.en: This is wrong, and especially dangerous in the following situations:

blocks.zh: 預填充注射器灌裝：注射器桶（barrel）既是藥品容器，也是器材組件。CDMO 灌裝時接觸的是器材零件，Part 820 要求（尤其是 §820.60 識別、§820.80 驗收活動、§820.86 合格狀態）適用於注射器桶的管理。
blocks.en: Prefilled syringe filling: The syringe barrel is both a drug container and a device component. What the CDMO handles during filling is a device part, so the Part 820 requirements (especially §820.60 identification, §820.80 acceptance activities and §820.86 acceptance status) apply to the management of the syringe barrel.

blocks.zh: 自動注射器總成：即使藥品已由另一家廠商完成灌裝，CDMO 若負責最終組裝（assembling drug vial + auto-injector body），則其操作已跨入 Part 820 管轄範圍。
blocks.en: Autoinjector assembly: Even if the drug has already been filled by another manufacturer, if the CDMO is responsible for final assembly (assembling the drug vial + autoinjector body), its operations have crossed into Part 820 jurisdiction.

blocks.zh: 貼附藥片的貼片系統：藥品貼片（drug-eluting patch）的基材（backing）是器材成分，CDMO 若參與基材與藥品的整合製程，Part 820 就適用。
blocks.en: Drug-eluting patch systems: The backing of a drug-eluting patch is a device constituent part. If the CDMO takes part in the process that integrates the backing with the drug, Part 820 applies.

blocks.zh: 判斷準則：只要 CDMO 的製造操作「接觸、操控或整合」器材成分，Part 820 的相關要求就適用於該操作，無論主要業務定位為藥廠或非藥廠。
blocks.en: Test: As long as the CDMO's manufacturing operation "touches, manipulates or integrates" a device constituent part, the relevant Part 820 requirements apply to that operation, regardless of whether its primary business is positioned as a pharmaceutical or non-pharmaceutical manufacturer.

blocks.zh: 品質協議：變更管理條款的重要性
blocks.en: Quality Agreement: The Importance of Change Management Clauses

blocks.zh: 組合產品品質協議中最容易疏漏的是變更管理分工。以下是常見糾紛情境：
blocks.en: The item most easily overlooked in a combination product quality agreement is the allocation of change management. A common dispute scenario:

blocks.zh: 情境： CDMO 自行決定將灌裝設備的某個接觸零件（product-contact part）的材質從 316L 不鏽鋼改為 Hastelloy C-276（供應鏈因素）。CDMO 認為這只是設備材質改變，屬於其製造主權範圍，無需通知客戶。
blocks.en: Scenario: The CDMO decides on its own to change the material of a product-contact part of its filling equipment from 316L stainless steel to Hastelloy C-276 (for supply chain reasons). The CDMO considers this only an equipment material change, within its own manufacturing discretion, and does not notify the client.

blocks.zh: 問題： 對藥品主導的組合產品，這個材質變更：
blocks.en: Question: For a drug-led combination product, this material change:

blocks.zh: 可能觸發 §211.68 的設備變更評估
blocks.en: May trigger an equipment change assessment under §211.68

blocks.zh: 可能需要重新評估 E&L 研究（容器/設備接觸材料的可萃取物）
blocks.en: May require reassessment of the E&L study (extractables of container/equipment contact materials)

blocks.zh: 可能觸發 NDA CMC 報告（取決於原先提交的設備描述詳細程度）
blocks.en: May trigger NDA CMC reporting (depending on the level of detail of the equipment description originally submitted)

blocks.zh: 如果器材成分也涉及（如注射器），可能還需要 §820.30 設計變更評估
blocks.en: If a device constituent part is also involved (such as a syringe), may also require a §820.30 design change assessment

blocks.zh: 品質協議應明確規定：所有接觸材料的變更，無論多「微小」，均需向 NDA/PMA 持有人報告，由後者評估是否觸發法規路徑。
blocks.en: The quality agreement should clearly specify: all changes to contact materials, however "minor," must be reported to the NDA/PMA holder, who then assesses whether a regulatory pathway is triggered.

blocks.zh: 多廠址製造的合規協調 Multi-Site Compliance Coordination
blocks.en: Multi-Site Compliance Coordination

blocks.zh: 分散式製造（split-site manufacturing）的最大挑戰：批次記錄的完整性。
blocks.en: The biggest challenge of split-site manufacturing is the integrity of batch records.

blocks.zh: FDA 要求能追蹤組合產品的每個成分到其製造地點的批次記錄。當藥品 Site A、器材 Site B、總裝 Site C 分屬不同公司，批次記錄的收集、核對和保存責任必須在品質協議中明確規定：
blocks.en: FDA requires batch records that can trace each constituent part of the combination product to its manufacturing site. When the drug (Site A), the device (Site B) and final assembly (Site C) belong to different companies, the responsibility for collecting, reconciling and retaining batch records must be clearly specified in the quality agreement:

blocks.zh: Site A 的 BPR 複印件何時、以何種格式傳送給 Site C？
blocks.en: When, and in what format, are copies of Site A's BPR sent to Site C?

blocks.zh: Site B 的 DHR 複印件何時、以何種格式傳送給 Site C？
blocks.en: When, and in what format, are copies of Site B's DHR sent to Site C?

blocks.zh: Site C 的品質主管是否有資格（和授權）審核 Site A 和 Site B 的記錄？
blocks.en: Is Site C's quality head qualified (and authorized) to review the records of Site A and Site B?

blocks.zh: 批次放行由誰負責——Site C 的 QP/QU？NDA 持有人的 QU？
blocks.en: Who is responsible for batch release: Site C's QP/QU, or the NDA holder's QU?

blocks.zh: 責任分配練習 Responsibility Allocation Exercise
blocks.en: Responsibility Allocation Exercise

blocks.zh: 請判斷以下 CDMO 情境中，哪些 CGMP 框架適用：
blocks.en: For each of the following CDMO scenarios, determine which CGMP frameworks apply:

blocks.zh: CDMO 負責 mAb 藥液的配製和過濾（bulk drug substance），最終交給客戶灌裝到預填充注射器。→ 適用哪些 CGMP？
blocks.en: The CDMO handles compounding and filtration of mAb drug solution (bulk drug substance), which is then handed to the client for filling into prefilled syringes. → Which CGMPs apply?

blocks.zh: CDMO 負責藥品主導自動注射器的最終組裝和目視檢查（藥品已由其他廠商灌裝），然後交給客戶包裝。→ 適用哪些 CGMP？
blocks.en: The CDMO handles final assembly and visual inspection of a drug-led autoinjector (the drug was filled by another manufacturer), then hands it to the client for packaging. → Which CGMPs apply?

blocks.zh: CDMO 提供 EO 滅菌服務，客戶的組合產品（含藥品和器材成分的最終組合體）在 CDMO 廠房完成滅菌。→ 適用哪些 CGMP？
blocks.en: The CDMO provides EO sterilization services, and the client's combination product (the final assembly of drug and device constituent parts) is sterilized at the CDMO's site. → Which CGMPs apply?

blocks.zh: CDMO 只負責標籤貼附和成品包裝，不接觸藥品或器材的主要組件。→ 適用哪些 CGMP？
blocks.en: The CDMO only handles labeling and finished product packaging, and does not touch the main components of the drug or device. → Which CGMPs apply?

blocks.zh: 3.5 FDA Inspection Implications for Combination Products 3.5 FDA 查廠對組合產品的意涵
blocks.en: 3.5 FDA Inspection Implications for Combination Products

blocks.zh: Inspection Framework 查廠框架
blocks.en: Inspection Framework

blocks.zh: 雙中心查廠的心理準備 Preparing for Dual-Center Inspection
blocks.en: Preparing for Dual-Center Inspection

blocks.zh: 組合產品製造商面臨的最大查廠挑戰是：同一個問題，兩種問法。
blocks.en: The biggest inspection challenge for combination product manufacturers is: one issue, two ways of asking.

blocks.zh: 例：關於變更管理，CDER 調查員會問：「這個製造變更是否提交了 NDA 補充申請？」CDRH 調查員會問：「這個設計變更是否經過 §820.30(i) 設計驗證/確認，並有設計評審記錄？」
blocks.en: Example: on change management, a CDER investigator will ask, "Was an NDA supplement submitted for this manufacturing change?" A CDRH investigator will ask, "Did this design change go through design verification/validation under §820.30(i), with design review records?"

blocks.zh: 品保人員必須能夠從兩個角度回答同一個操作決策。這需要在內部溝通培訓中特別強調：藥品 QA 人員需要了解器材 QSR 的語言，器材 QA 人員需要了解藥品 CGMP 的語言。
blocks.en: QA staff must be able to answer the same operational decision from both angles. This needs to be emphasized in internal communication and training: drug QA staff need to understand the language of the device QSR, and device QA staff need to understand the language of drug CGMP.

blocks.zh: OAI 的連鎖效應 The OAI Cascade Effect
blocks.en: The OAI Cascade Effect

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 來說，OAI 的連鎖效應比單一藥廠或器材廠更嚴重：
blocks.en: For a CDMO, the cascade effect of an OAI is more serious than for a single drug or device manufacturer:

blocks.zh: CDMO 自身的 OAI 不只影響一個客戶，而是可能影響所有在該廠房製造組合產品的客戶
blocks.en: A CDMO's own OAI does not affect just one client; it may affect every client whose combination products are made at that site

blocks.zh: 如果 OAI 導致廠房進入 Import Alert，所有在該廠房製造的產品（包括非組合產品的藥品或器材）都可能受到波及
blocks.en: If an OAI leads to the site being placed on Import Alert, all products made at the site (including drug or device products that are not combination products) may be affected

blocks.zh: 客戶端（NDA/PMA 持有人）的審批進程可能因 CDMO 的 OAI 而全面暫停
blocks.en: The client's (NDA/PMA holder's) approval process may be put fully on hold because of the CDMO's OAI

blocks.zh: CDMO 必須在品質協議中明確規定：CDMO 若收到任何中心的 Form 483 或 Warning Letter，必須在多少工作日內通知客戶，並提供觀察項目的全文
blocks.en: The CDMO must specify in the quality agreement that if it receives a Form 483 or Warning Letter from any center, it must notify the client within a set number of working days and provide the full text of the observations

blocks.zh: 483 高頻觀察項目 High-Frequency 483 Observations for Combo Products
blocks.en: High-Frequency 483 Observations for Combo Products

blocks.zh: 根據 FDA 公開的 483 觀察和警告信，組合產品製造商最常被引用的問題：
blocks.en: Based on publicly available FDA 483 observations and warning letters, the issues most frequently cited for combination product manufacturers are:

blocks.zh: 客訴系統未包含 MDR 可報性評估步驟（§820.198 + Part 803）
blocks.en: The complaint system does not include an MDR reportability assessment step (§820.198 + Part 803)

blocks.zh: BPR 未整合 DHR 必要元素（§820.184）——缺少器材成分追溯記錄
blocks.en: The BPR does not integrate the required DHR elements (§820.184), leaving device constituent part traceability records missing

blocks.zh: 無 §820.100 CAPA 的顯性程序（依賴偏差管理隱性代替 CAPA）
blocks.en: No explicit §820.100 CAPA procedure (relying on deviation management as an implicit substitute for CAPA)

blocks.zh: 製程驗證未考量器材成分的 §820.75 要求
blocks.en: Process validation does not consider the §820.75 requirements for device constituent parts

blocks.zh: 雙重 CGMP 交叉比對文件不存在或過時
blocks.en: The dual CGMP cross-reference document does not exist or is out of date

blocks.zh: 供應商管理未包含器材成分供應商的 §820.50 核准評估（只有 §211.84 進料測試記錄）
blocks.en: Supplier management does not include the §820.50 approval assessment for device constituent part suppliers (only §211.84 incoming testing records)

blocks.zh: 完整 CDMO 情境應用 Full CDMO Application Scenario
blocks.en: Full CDMO Application Scenario

blocks.zh: 情境：mAb 自動注射器 —— CDMO 負責灌裝與目視檢查
blocks.en: Scenario: mAb autoinjector, with the CDMO responsible for filling and visual inspection

blocks.zh: 產品： 藥品主導組合產品（CDER 主導）。mAb 藥液灌裝入預填充注射器，再組裝進自動注射器機身。
blocks.en: Product: A drug-led combination product (CDER lead). The mAb drug solution is filled into prefilled syringes, which are then assembled into the autoinjector body.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的工作範圍： 接收預先滅菌的注射器桶（device component，由 Device CDMO B 供應）→ 灌裝 mAb 藥液 → 執行容器封閉完整性測試（CCIT）→ 目視檢查（注射器 + 藥液） → 冷藏儲存待交客戶進行自動注射器組裝。
blocks.en: CDMO scope of work: Receive pre-sterilized syringe barrels (device component, supplied by Device CDMO B) → fill the mAb drug solution → perform container closure integrity testing (CCIT) → visual inspection (syringe + drug solution) → refrigerated storage pending handover to the client for autoinjector assembly.

blocks.zh: 適用 CGMP 分析：
blocks.en: Applicable CGMP analysis:

blocks.zh: Part 211 適用： mAb 藥液灌裝（§211.113 無菌灌裝）、環境監控（§211.113(b)）、BPR（§211.188）、客訴（§211.198，ADE 評估）、進料測試（§211.84，對 API 和注射器桶）
blocks.en: Part 211 applies: mAb drug solution filling (§211.113 aseptic filling), environmental monitoring (§211.113(b)), BPR (§211.188), complaints (§211.198, ADE assessment), incoming testing (§211.84, for the API and the syringe barrels)

blocks.zh: Part 820 適用（因接觸器材成分）： 注射器桶的接收檢查（§820.80 驗收活動）、注射器桶的身份標識（§820.60）、CCIT 作為最終成品測試（§820.80(d)）、CAPA（§820.100）
blocks.en: Part 820 applies (because device constituent parts are handled): receiving inspection of syringe barrels (§820.80 acceptance activities), identification of syringe barrels (§820.60), CCIT as finished product testing (§820.80(d)), CAPA (§820.100)

blocks.zh: 交叉比對需說明： §820.184 DHR → CDMO 的 BPR 應包含注射器桶批號（device component lot）作為 DHR 元素；§820.198 客訴 → CDMO 的客訴 SOP 需增加 MDR 評估步驟
blocks.en: The cross-reference must explain: §820.184 DHR → the CDMO's BPR should include the syringe barrel lot number (device component lot) as a DHR element; §820.198 complaints → the CDMO's complaint SOP needs an added MDR assessment step

blocks.zh: 品質協議關鍵條款： 注射器桶的 CoA 和 DHF 由 Device CDMO B 提供；CDMO 之 BPR 中的 DHR 元素如何傳遞給最終組裝商；mAb CDMO 在發現任何 CCIT 失敗時的 MDR 評估責任；任何 483 觀察必須在 3 個工作日內通知 NDA 持有人。
blocks.en: Key quality agreement clauses: the CoA and DHF for the syringe barrels are provided by Device CDMO B; how the DHR elements in the CDMO's BPR are passed to the final assembler; the mAb CDMO's responsibility for MDR assessment when any CCIT failure is found; any 483 observation must be notified to the NDA holder within 3 working days.

blocks.zh: Section 3 Summary 本章摘要
blocks.en: Section 3 Summary

blocks.zh: Key Takeaways 核心要點
blocks.en: Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: 雙重 CGMP 的本質是文件化等效性，不是雙倍工作量。 §4.4(b) 的精簡化路徑允許一套系統滿足兩套要求，但前提是有清晰的交叉比對文件（Gap Analysis Crosswalk）——這份文件是 FDA 查廠時的核心證物。
blocks.en: The essence of dual CGMP is documented equivalence, not double the workload. The streamlined approach in §4.4(b) allows one system to satisfy both sets of requirements, but only with a clear cross-reference document (Gap Analysis Crosswalk), which is the core exhibit during an FDA inspection.

blocks.zh: 六大核心領域各有整合要點。 CAPA（§820.100）是藥廠出身的 CDMO 最需要補充的顯性要求；BPR/DHR 整合是記錄管理的關鍵挑戰；變更管控需同時評估 Part 211 和 Part 820 的觸發點。
blocks.en: Each of the six core areas has its own integration points. CAPA (§820.100) is the explicit requirement that CDMOs from a pharmaceutical background most need to add; BPR/DHR integration is the key challenge in record management; change control must assess the triggers under both Part 211 and Part 820.

blocks.zh: 上市後報告是雙軌制。 ADE 報告走 FAERS/CDER 路徑；MDR 走 CDRH/Part 803 路徑。CDMO 作為製造商對 MDR 有獨立評估義務，不能依賴 NDA 持有人的 ADE 報告替代。品質協議中的不良事件報告分工條款不可省略。
blocks.en: Post-market reporting is a dual-track system. ADE reports follow the FAERS/CDER pathway; MDRs follow the CDRH/Part 803 pathway. As a manufacturer, the CDMO has an independent obligation to assess MDRs and cannot rely on the NDA holder's ADE report as a substitute. The adverse event reporting allocation clauses in the quality agreement must not be omitted.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的責任邊界由實際操作決定，不由自我定位決定。 只要操作接觸器材成分，Part 820 就適用於該操作。「我們只做藥品灌裝」不是豁免器材 CGMP 的理由，特別是預填充注射器、藥品貼片、或自動注射器組裝情境。
blocks.en: A CDMO's responsibility boundary is determined by actual operations, not by self-positioning. Whenever an operation touches a device constituent part, Part 820 applies to that operation. "We only do drug filling" is not a reason to be exempt from device CGMP, especially in prefilled syringe, drug-eluting patch or autoinjector assembly scenarios.

blocks.zh: 分散式製造需要明確的批次記錄整合協議。 多廠址組合產品製造的最大合規風險是批次記錄碎片化——品質協議必須規定每個廠址的記錄格式、傳遞時限、整合責任，以及最終批次放行的授權主體。
blocks.en: Split-site manufacturing requires an explicit batch record integration agreement. The biggest compliance risk of multi-site combination product manufacturing is fragmented batch records. The quality agreement must specify each site's record format, transfer timelines, integration responsibility and the party authorized to release the final batch.

blocks.zh: 任一中心的 OAI 影響整個組合產品的市場准入。 對 CDMO 而言，這意味著維持雙中心合規的商業重要性不亞於法規合規重要性——一個廠房的 OAI 可能中斷多個客戶的產品供應，帶來嚴重的商業後果。
blocks.en: An OAI from either center affects market access for the entire combination product. For a CDMO, this means maintaining dual-center compliance is as commercially important as it is a regulatory matter: an OAI at one site can interrupt product supply for multiple clients, with serious commercial consequences.
